

THE TECHNOLOGY OF AI SHOULDNT BE A THING TO FEAR AND REJECT IT SHOULD INSTEAD BE EMBRACED AND USED INTELLIGENTLY BUT CULTURAL THEMES OF PRECIVED DANGER SEEM TO STOP OUR CREATIVITY WITHOUT IT BEING A RATIONAL FEAR WHICH MAKES IT A PHOBIA OF AI THIS IS WASTED POTENTIAL UNDERSTANDING DEEP CONCEPTS IN AI WE ARE WASTING VALUABLE TIME WORRYING ABOUT CATASTROPHIZING EVENTS WHICH IS JUST AS LIKELY TO OCCURE AS IN COHESIVE RELIGOUS MYTHS THAT HAS NEVER NOR WILL EVER HAPPEEN DUE TO A LACK IN CHEMICAL AND PHYSICAL EMPIRICAL EVIDENCE THUS A PRIME EXAMPLE OF WHY WE SHOULD STOP FEARING OUR OWN TECHNOLOGICAL CREATIONS

The technology of AI shouldn't be a thing to fear and reject it, should instead be embraced and used intelligently, but cultural themes of precived danger seem to stop our creativity without it being a rational fear, which makes it a phobia of AI. This is wasted potential: understanding deep concepts in AI, we are wasting valuable time worrying about catastrophizing events which is just as likely to occure as in cohesive religous myths that has never nor will ever happeen due to a lack in chemical and physical empirical evidence. Thus a prime example of why we should stop fearing our own technological creations.
